outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 600 pregnant women categorised as low risk (no prenatal risk factors) at Khartoum North Maternity Hospital between January and June 2017
finding: Among low-risk pregnancies, 12.5% experienced serious obstetric and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: The frequency of primary cesarean delivery, forceps, and ventose among low-risk pregnancies in this study were 16%, 3%, and 2% respectively.
